$comment: Per-language facade surface model for the 36 modeled C functions in bindings/api.json. scripts/check-bindings.py validates every claim against the facade sources and regenerates bindings/conformance/completeness-matrix.tsv from this file. A null symbol is a deliberate modeled absence and must carry _reason; reasons prefixed with FINDING flag real cross-facade inconsistencies loudly without breaking the gate.

status._reason: the delegated NativeException.status returns the generated JVM Status enum and statusCode preserves unknown raw values; the deliberately thin facade does not duplicate them as Clojure keywords

llev_build_features._reason: not wrapped; phonetic availability surfaces at call time as the delegated NativeException with the UNSUPPORTED status

llev_last_error_message._reason: the delegated JVM NativeException (copied message + typed Status + exact raw statusCode) propagates unchanged; the deliberately thin facade does not introduce a second error wrapper
